overall: The AG found no violation: the Commission's members' separate conversations were not serial deliberation by a quorum, and the complainant was ultimately allowed to record the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged two Commission members deliberated on parking in a cemetery outside a posted meeting, implying serial deliberation by a quorum, between 2011 and 2013.
allegations.key_passage: More importantly, those conversations were not used as a vehicle to serially deliberate among a quorum of the public body because the opinion of one member of the Commission was not expressed to the other.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged he was not allowed to record the August 14, 2013 meeting; the Chair initially refused but later permitted recording.
allegations.key_passage: the complainant was allowed to record the meeting
